data.description: The Tunnel Dweller is an NPC you kill for components and basic supplies, and its loot table has no blueprints. [Metal Blades](/items/metal-blade) and Rope are the top drops at 28.5% each, then Medical Syringes at 16.7% and [Empty Propane Tanks](/items/empty-propane-tank), [Sewing Kits](/items/sewing-kit) and [Tarps](/items/tarp) at 15.4%. Pistol Bullets and 5.56 Rifle Ammo each show up 11.1% of the time. A Hazmat Suit is rare at 1.8%. Harvest the body for up to 30 bone fragments and 5 cloth.
